content: A couple of other things we've built — feel free to drop by if any of these sound useful to you.

sites.information: India's government sites aggregator — brings together official government links across every state and union territory of India, in one place.
A private, no-login home reference app — for household DIY fixes, everyday tips, and recipes from every state of India and country in the world.

A single-page tool that formats, validates, and converts data across formats like JSON, YAML, XML, CSV, and more, plus a text comparison tab. Its name nods to 'Ekam' (Sanskrit for 'one') — one tool for handling many formats in one place.
